prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: revised high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render the complete edge-to-edge first viewport for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, a Vietnamese multi-center tutoring operations product. The visitor must understand the connected flow from center approval and role access to scheduling and attendance, then sign in.
Real content: “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”; headline “Một nhịp vận hành, mọi trung tâm”; stages “Duyệt trung tâm”, “Phân quyền”, “Xếp lịch”, “Điểm danh”; form labels “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu”; actions “Đăng nhập”, “Quên mật khẩu?”.
Composition: use ONE dominant move only: a monumental operations dossier / routing sheet fills almost the entire viewport as one continuous object. Its four indexed folders unfold in sequence from left to right, linked by a visible routing trace. The final open tab contains the functional login form. A compact mark and minimal navigation sit quietly inside the dossier’s top binding edge; a narrow continuation below shows only today’s next two sessions, never a full dashboard. No buildings, cityscape, decorative hero illustration, sidebar, metrics wall, or separate competing panel.
Visual law: cool fibrous white ground, deep navy institutional ink, jade verified states, mango pending, vermilion exception. Vietnamese-friendly sturdy grotesk, crisp tabs, flat stamps, generous quiet areas. Modern, calm, accountable, tactile without looking bureaucratic.
Constraints: readable Vietnamese, real website interface, one dominant object, no generic split hero, no browser/device mockup, no stock photos, no glassmorphism, no generic gradient, no watermark.
